tailoring.headline: Senior B2B Commerce Developer | SAP Commerce Cloud, Java, Spring, API Integration
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years delivering large-scale B2B e-commerce platforms on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, Spring Boot, RESTful and OCC APIs, and JavaScript-enabled headless commerce. Proven record designing PIM/ERP data pipelines, API migrations, and high-performance integrations. Skilled in CI/CD, Docker/Kubernetes, and agile techno-functional consulting, translating business requirements into robust commerce solutions.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Salesforce B2B Commerce Developer
cover_en.hook: Having led SAP Commerce Cloud initiatives at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am excited by your focus on building robust B2B commerce experiences. My five-plus years of designing headless APIs, integrating PIM/ERP data, and delivering high-performance e-commerce platforms align directly with the challenges of your Salesforce B2B Commerce projects.

bullets.label: API Development
bullets.text: Designed and exposed OCC REST Web Services for headless storefronts and third-party consumers, ensuring secure, high-throughput API access.

bullets.label: Data Integration
bullets.text: Built PIM-to-Hybris pipelines using Profisee, Hotfolders and DataHub, synchronizing product data across global channels.

bullets.label: B2B Commerce
bullets.text: Delivered end-to-end B2B/B2C commerce solutions on SAP Commerce Cloud, covering product catalog, pricing, and order management.

bullets.label: Agile Delivery
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles on CCv2, led code reviews and provided production support within Scrum teams.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe, Germany, I hold a valid German work permit, am serving notice until 15 December 2026 and can start on 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how I can contribute.

tailoring.why_company: Your commitment to expanding Salesforce B2B Commerce solutions for enterprise clients resonates with my passion for creating scalable, API-driven commerce platforms. I am eager to bring my deep experience in SAP Commerce Cloud, headless integrations, and techno-functional consulting to help accelerate your customers’ digital transformation, improve time-to-market, and ensure seamless product data synchronization across systems.
tailoring.motivation_short: Eager to apply my SAP Commerce expertise to drive innovative B2B commerce solutions within your Salesforce ecosystem, delivering fast, reliable integrations and superior customer experiences.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti, a senior SAP Commerce Cloud developer with 5+ years delivering B2B e-commerce platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell. I’m keen to discuss how my API and integration experience can add value to your Salesforce B2B Commerce team.
tailoring.offer: In the first months I will modernize your B2B commerce API layer by leveraging my experience building OCC REST services and integrating PIM/ERP data pipelines. This will accelerate product data synchronization and improve platform stability for your Salesforce Commerce Cloud initiatives.
tailoring.insight: Your posting emphasizes strong API expertise; my background designing OCC REST APIs and migration projects will directly support that need.
tailoring.email_subject: Application for Salesforce B2B Commerce Developer – Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body: Dear Hiring Team, I am Kranti Chavan, a senior SAP Commerce Cloud developer with over five years of B2B e-commerce experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell. Your focus on robust API development for Salesforce B2B Commerce aligns with my proven track record building OCC REST services and PIM/ERP integrations. I can quickly enhance your API layer and ensure seamless data flow. I have noted your emphasis on API excellence and am ready to contribute from day one. Please find my CV and cover letter attached.
